data.define: Used to tell someone to feel better.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cheer up' to someone grieving.
misuse.why: It sounds like you dismiss their pain.

data.l1_hook: वह उदास दिख रही है। अब क्या? चलो 'cheer up' करें।
data.l1_ex: Cheer up, हम पिज़्ज़ा खा रहे हैं!

native.tip: “cheer up” = खुश होना. उदाहरण: “Cheer up, we're having pizza!”
